_comment: Router models and serving-provider legs the pricing page lists without a price (they render "Not published"). gen-router-pricing.ts --check fails on any unpriced route missing here, on a waiver without a reason or evidence, on a waiver whose status is not embargoed or catalog_only_not_dispatchable, and on a stale waiver whose route is now priced, so this list can only shrink. A route Router actually dispatches (status live) can never be waived: publish its price in metronome-rates.json. Verify status against Comfy-Org/cloud: embargoed = held platform-wide by embargoed_models (infrastructure/dynamicconfig/prod/comfy-api.json); catalog_only_not_dispatchable = in the Router catalog but its operation has no services/comfy-api/routerresult/classification.go row, so Router refuses dispatch. provider is the accordion the row appears under: Comfy for the model's own provider, otherwise the alternate's name as listed under Serving providers on the model page.

waivers.evidence: Comfy-Org/cloud@c12741305f services/comfy-api/server/middleware/router_model_classification_test.go:232 (routerKnownUnclassifiedOperations); services/comfy-api/openapi.yml:66430 (COMFY ROUTER DOES NOT RUN THIS MODEL TODAY)
waivers.reason: Listed in the Router catalog, but its operation (fal /clarityai/crystal-upscaler) has no routerresult classification row, so POST /v2/models/fal/crystal-upscaler is refused before dispatch. It runs only on the /proxy/fal/clarityai/crystal-upscaler partner route, whose rate is not a Router price.
